metadata.title: Final Mechanism-Level Differential Privacy Audit and Formal Verification

mechanism_trace.exact_noise_addition_locus: LOCAL CLIENT LEVEL. Each client i independently clips its local parameter delta to L2 norm <= C=8.0 and adds independent Gaussian noise eta_i ~ N(0, (sigma*C)^2 I_d) before encryption and transmission.

adversarial_observation_transcripts.view_1_untrusted_server_without_paillier: Observes each noisy client delta hat{Delta}_i = tilde{Delta}_i + eta_i individually. Effective noise per client is sigma_param = sigma * C.
adversarial_observation_transcripts.view_2_honest_but_curious_server_with_pa: Observes only Paillier ciphertexts [[hat{Delta}_i]]. Can compute homomorphic sum [[sum_i hat{Delta}_i]] mod N^2. Has ZERO plaintext visibility into individual client updates.
adversarial_observation_transcripts.view_3_released_global_model_analyst: Observes the decrypted global aggregate delta_global = (1/K) sum_{i=1}^K tilde{Delta}_i + (1/K) sum_{i=1}^K eta_i. The accumulated noise is the average of K=3 independent Gaussian vectors.

view3_released_aggregate_add_remove.adversary_view: Released global model (or external analyst observing decrypted aggregate)
view3_released_aggregate_add_remove.client_adjacency: Add/Remove client (or null-baseline participation): D' = D \ {D_j}

view3_released_aggregate_replacement.adversary_view: Released global model (or external analyst observing decrypted aggregate)
view3_released_aggregate_replacement.client_adjacency: Replacement client (worst-case diametrically opposite delta): D_j -> D_j'

view1_single_client_server_bounded.adversary_view: Untrusted server in plaintext FedAvg (observing individual client updates)
view1_single_client_server_bounded.client_adjacency: Bounded client delta (relative to null update 0): ||tilde{Delta}_i|| <= C

view1_single_client_server_replacement.adversary_view: Untrusted server in plaintext FedAvg (observing individual client updates)

evaluation_at_sigma_001.verdict: FALSE ASSUMPTION REFUTED. Even with q=0.05, if sigma remains 0.01, epsilon is approx 208.4. While reduced by 200x from 41,357, epsilon=208 is STILL information-theoretically unbounded (e^208 = inf). Subsampling alone cannot produce formal DP without increasing sigma.

evaluation_at_sigma_050.verdict: SUCCESSFUL REGIME. When combined with moderate noise sigma=0.50, subsampling q=0.05 yields formal privacy epsilon=4.22 (delta=1e-5).

dimension_reduction.mathematical_fact: The formal DP guarantee (epsilon, delta) for the Gaussian mechanism depends SOLELY on sensitivity Delta_2, noise multiplier sigma_eff, rounds T, and delta. Parameter dimension d DOES NOT appear anywhere in the privacy budget formula.
dimension_reduction.impact_on_epsilon: EXACTLY ZERO. Compressing model parameters from d=11,206 to d=500 does not alter epsilon by even 0.00000001 if clipping bound C and noise multiplier sigma are unchanged.
dimension_reduction.impact_on_utility_snr: CRITICAL UTILITY IMPROVEMENT. The expected L2 norm of the Gaussian perturbation vector is E[||eta||_2] approx sigma * C * sqrt(d). Compressing d from 11,206 to 500 reduces the expected noise magnitude by sqrt(11206 / 500) = 4.73x (a 78.9% noise norm reduction), allowing the model to train effectively under formal privacy noise.

verified_claims: Under Paillier PHE, the released aggregate has effective noise multiplier sigma_eff = sigma * sqrt(3) under add/remove adjacency, yielding exact epsilon = 14,116.93 (delta=1e-5) for C=8, sigma=0.01, T=8.
Under replacement adjacency, the released aggregate has effective noise multiplier sigma_eff = sigma * sqrt(3) / 2, yielding exact epsilon = 54,900.53 (delta=1e-5).

If the adversary is an untrusted aggregation server observing unencrypted updates (plaintext FedAvg), the single-client privacy budget is epsilon = 41,357.23 (bounded norm) or 162,714.46 (replacement).
Mironov (2017) continuous RDP Proposition 3 infimum matches the exact Balle & Wang (2018) Gaussian CDF privacy curve with zero error gap.
Paillier 512-bit PHE induces 0.0000% accuracy penalty under identical inputs.
unresolved_or_restricted_claims: Record-Level DP is technically unverified and unbounded due to unclipped local Adam SGD.
Current operating point (sigma=0.01) is strictly empirical gradient perturbation; formal DP requires sigma >= 0.50.
Subsampling rate q=0.05 alone with sigma=0.01 still leaves epsilon > 200; increasing sigma to >= 0.50 is mandatory for formal DP.
